title: WaterColor "Sandy Feet" 325 Western Lake Drive
description_expanded: HOME HIGHLIGHTS: *Per Watercolor HOA, please include all guests aged 5 and older in your total count of adult guests to receive amenity and pool access wristbands. Sleep arrangements are provided as a courtesy and are not considered in the occupancy count.**This home is allowed 16 amenity access bands.**- Short walk to the beach- Private Pool **Pool heating available Oct 1-May 1 for $50 per day**- Panoramic views of Western Lake- Newly renovated - Sprawling porches- Subzero/Wolf kitchen appliances- Carriage house- 2-car garage- 6 adult bikes- Complete Clean Linen Participant - ALL linens, including comforter covers, are laundered upon every checkoutGuests staying in WaterColor will have access to the newly expanded WaterColor Beach Club. It features a new main pool and lounge area, second pool deck with additional lounge seating, and third pool with zero-entry, as well an enhanced WaterColor Grill, and new sunset bar, Costa Chica. All have scenic views of the Gulf of Mexico.DETAILS: Tucked away among lush surrounding flora is a 30A getaway like no other. This 6-bedroom, 6.5-bathroom features panoramic views of Western Lake, a carriage house, and an amazing chef's kitchen. Walnut floors and shiplap walls accent this newly renovated gem. The French Colonial-inspired architecture allows for wonderful outdoor spaces, including sprawling balconies and a private pool where friends and family can gather for the vacation of a lifetime. The first floor is home to 2 guest bedrooms with king beds, both with private bathrooms, one with shower only and the other with shower/tub combo. The second floor - the heart of this retreat - is where you'll find the primary bedroom featuring balcony access and a private bathroom with a shower and soaking tub. Two more guest bedrooms are on the third floor, both with 2 twin bunk beds, 1 twin sleeper, and private bathrooms. Make your way to the gourmet kitchen on the second floor, which is something to behold: A gas range, top-of-the-line Wolf and Subzero appliances, marble countertops, and designer cabinets. It opens to the dining and living rooms highlighted by box beam ceilings and crisp white colors. Just off the kitchen is a wonderfully convenient wet bar, complete with a wine fridge, ice-maker, and sink. Balcony access and proximity to the wet bar makes for a wonderful evening spent with loved ones. Adjacent to the main house is the fully self-sufficient carriage house, complete with a kitchenette, walnut floors, balcony, queen bed, and a bathroom with shower only. This WaterColor retreat sleeps 16.The focal point of the outdoor spaces is, of course, the private pool. Spend mornings at the most beautiful beaches in the world and afternoons poolside with cocktails among friends and family. The balconies overlook the WaterColor neighborhood and all the natural beauty of Western Lake. Book today!SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS: FIRST FLOOR- Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower Only- Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower/Tub ComboSECOND FLOOR- Primary Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower and TubTHIRD FLOOR- Guest Bedroom: Two Twin Bunk Beds and Twin Sleeper, Private Bathroom with Shower Only- Guest Bedroom: Two Twin Bunk Beds and Twin Sleeper, Private Bathroom with Shower/Tub ComboCARRIAGE HOUSE- Guest Bedroom: Queen Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower OnlyWeddings are not allowed at this home.
